title: Second Earth in Night Sky
content: Last night (2 AM CST) I was just walking around the astral version of my neighborhood when all of a sudden I saw a second Earth in the night sky with a moon orbiting it. There was a lone moon in one side of the sky and in the other side there was just a replica of Earth. When I saw Earth up in the sky, I managed to go to that particular world and ended up inside a classroom. Inside that classroom we were doing some type of vocabulary and art project. The art was used as a way to describe the words that were written. Although I don't remember that much regarding the words and art that I saw in the dream, I do know that the environment in that world felt extremely nice. This has been the second time I have seen the second Earth in the night sky, and I do enjoy going to that particular world where it's filled with genuine love.
